'''August 2000 Williston Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Grasshoppers Comics, Williston Park, NY on 19 August 2000. [[Bucksun Lee]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1146">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-19-williston-park-ny-8-19-00-buck-winsd1146/ williston-park-ny-8-19-00-buck-wins], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 19 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-19-williston-park-ny-8-19-00-buck-winsd1146/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Grasshoppers Comics, Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Bucksun Lee]]
